sentences.text: Bahrain -LRB- -LSB- bɑːˈreɪn -RSB- البحرين -RRB- , officially the Kingdom of Bahrain , is a small Arab monarchy in the Arabian Gulf .	Arab	Arab	Arabian Gulf	Arabian Gulf

It is an island country consisting of a small archipelago centered around Bahrain Island , situated between the Qatar peninsula and the north eastern coast of Saudi Arabia , to which it is connected by the 25 km King Fahd Causeway .	King	King	island country	island country	archipelago	archipelago	Bahrain Island	Bahrain Island	Qatar	Qatar	Saudi Arabia	Saudi Arabia	King Fahd Causeway	King Fahd Causeway
Bahrain 's population is 1,234,571 -LRB- c. 2010 -RRB- , including 666,172 non-nationals .

It is 780 km2 in size , making it the third smallest nation in Asia after the Maldives and Singapore .	smallest nation	List of sovereign states and dependencies by area	Maldives	Maldives	Singapore	Singapore
Bahrain is the site of the ancient Dilmun civilisation .	Dilmun civilisation	Dilmun civilisation
It has been famed since antiquity for its pearl fisheries , which were considered the best in the world into the 19th century .	pearl fisheries	pearl fisheries
Bahrain was one of the earliest areas to convert to Islam -LRB- 628 -RRB- .	Islam	Islam

Following a period of Arab rule , Bahrain was occupied by the Portuguese in 1521 , who in turn were expelled in 1602 by Shah Abbas I of the Safavid dynasty under the Persian Empire .	Arab	Arab	Portuguese	Portugal	Shah	Shah	Abbas I	Abbas I of Persia	Safavid dynasty	Safavid dynasty	Persian Empire	Persian Empire

In 1783 , the Bani Utbah clan captured Bahrain from Nasr Al-Madhkur and it has since been ruled by the Al Khalifa royal family , with Ahmed al Fateh as Bahrain 's first hakim . In the late 1800s , following successive treaties with the British , Bahrain became a protectorate of the United Kingdom .	United Kingdom	United Kingdom	British	United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland	protectorate	protectorate
In 1971 , Bahrain declared independence .	declared independence	Independence Day (Bahrain)
Formerly an emirate , Bahrain was declared a Kingdom in 2002 .	emirate	State of Bahrain
